responsibility: Handles later and translation-unit-wide declaration work that complements decl.c. It builds member-function types, tracks deferred inline and static declarations, manages namespace-scope construction/destruction lists and init priorities, emits constructor/destructor helper functions for static storage duration, decides visibility/import-export and mangling aliases, records ODR use and forces needed template or defaulted-member instantiations, and drives end-of-file declaration finalization.
